lastResponse.text: You never need to apologize. You’re overwhelmed, and you’re still taking a brave step right now. I don’t want to guess about insurance, but the Crisis Counseling Hotline can tell you right away and help you either Way. Call five-four-one, six-eight-seven, four-zero-zero-zero. That’s five four one, six eight seven, four zero zero zero. If you want, we can do it together now, one breath at a time. If you feel unsafe at any point, call nine one one immediately.
originalTexts: You never need to apologize. You’re overwhelmed, and you’re still taking a brave step right now. I don’t want to guess about insurance, but the **Crisis Counseling Hotline** can tell you right away and help you either way. Call **five-four-one, six-eight-seven, four-zero-zero-zero**. That’s **(541) 687-4000**. If you want, we can do it together now, one breath at a time. If you feel unsafe at any point, call **911** immediately.
